subject: Math
prompt:
[Figure 1]

In the right triangle shown, angle $x$ measures $62°$ and the hypotenuse is $23$ millimeters. Which of the following is closest to the length, in millimeters, of the shorter leg?
explanation: Since angle $x = 62°$, the other acute angle is $90° - 62° = 28°$. The shorter leg is opposite the smaller angle (28°), which is also adjacent to angle $x$. Using cosine: shorter leg $= 23 \cos(62°) \approx 23(0.469) \approx 10.8$.
